q: The spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators T: H → H on an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space states the eigenvalues {λₙ} satisfy:
opts: Eigenvalues accumulate only at 0, and there is an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors (possibly infinite)
exp: Compact self-adjoint operators: the nonzero eigenvalues form a sequence λₙ → 0 (accumulating only at 0), each of finite multiplicity, and the eigenvectors form a complete orthonormal system. This is the Hilbert-Schmidt theorem — the infinite-dimensional analogue of eigendecomposition.
